name: Yang I
bio: Yang I is dated by Giles to the late 10th and early 11th centuries AD. His poem here is a four-line verse written from a high pagoda.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: 'Twixt Heaven and Earth
poems.author: Yang I
poems.text:
Upon this tall pagoda's peak
My hands can nigh the stars enclose-,
I dare not raise my voice to speak,
For fear of startling God's repose.
